Prickly Pear
Family  Cactaceae
Scientific name Opuntia ficus-indica
Common name prickly pear, Indian fig,
nopal, nopalitos, Sharon’s fruit
♥High in vitamin C and magnesium
♥A good source of fiber
ripe, the fruits yield when gently pressed.
Ripe fruits can be stored in a perforated
plastic bag in the refrigerator up to 2 days.  
Prickly pears are refreshing when
eaten with a sprinkle of lime or lemon
juice.  They can be diced and used to top
ice cream, sorbet, yogurt, and various
desserts, or they can be puréed to make
marmalade and dessert sauces.  The pads
(nopales), which are served as a vegetable,
